description: Worked across the stack, with React on the frontend and Express and MongoDB on the backend. Integrated APIs like OpenWeather and Leaflet into student-facing apps. Also helped build SIMS, the college's student management system, where I owned the frontend. It now has 500+ registered students.

Elected Technical Co-Lead of CSI-CATT for 2026-27. I lead the technical side of the college's Computer Society chapter, which means planning workshops and events and guiding the chapter's dev projects. I joined as a contributor, so setting the direction is a big step up.

I've been freelancing since 2022 and handle everything myself: design, MERN development, deployment, and the final polish. Working solo means every project teaches me something new about what it takes to ship.
